bpdcn_primary.label: BPDCN: complete BPDCN workup/CNS evaluation, then CD123-directed or chemotherapy-based induction based on eligibility with transplant consolidation when appropriate.

recommendation.title: BPDCN: complete BPDCN workup/CNS evaluation, then CD123-directed or chemotherapy-based induction based on eligibility with transplant consolidation when appropriate.

options.label: CD123-directed therapy
options.text: Use tagraxofusp or pivekimab according to source eligibility/exclusion and CD123 expression.

options.label: Chemotherapy/non-intensive therapy
options.text: Use source alternatives when intensive/CD123-directed therapy is not suitable.

options.label: Allogeneic HCT
options.text: Consolidate in appropriate responders.

bpdcn_rr.label: Relapsed/refractory BPDCN: CD123-directed therapy not previously used, alternative systemic therapy/clinical trial, CNS-directed care, and transplant evaluation when feasible.

recommendation.title: Relapsed/refractory BPDCN: CD123-directed therapy not previously used, alternative systemic therapy/clinical trial, CNS-directed care, and transplant evaluation when feasible.

options.label: Pivekimab/tagraxofusp
options.text: Use source eligibility and prior exposure constraints.

options.label: Clinical trial/other systemic therapy
options.text: For patients not eligible or after prior CD123 therapy.

apl_rel.label: Relapsed APL: molecularly and prior-treatment-directed salvage to molecular remission followed by consolidation/transplant strategy per APL-6.

recommendation.title: Relapsed APL: molecularly and prior-treatment-directed salvage to molecular remission followed by consolidation/transplant strategy per APL-6.

options.label: Salvage
options.text: Use ATO/ATRA/anthracycline/GO-based approach based on prior exposure and relapse timing.

options.label: Consolidation/transplant
options.text: Use molecular response and prior therapy to direct autologous/allogeneic transplant or nontransplant consolidation.

apl_consolidation.label: APL after induction response: proceed with risk/regimen-specific consolidation and molecular response monitoring; do not restart induction by phase fallthrough.

recommendation.title: APL after induction response: proceed with risk/regimen-specific consolidation and molecular response monitoring; do not restart induction by phase fallthrough.

options.label: APL consolidation
options.text: Use the same risk/regimen family and source-defined consolidation schedule.

options.label: Molecular response assessment
options.text: PML::RARA assessment at the source-defined post-consolidation timepoint.

apl_monitor.label: APL post-consolidation: molecular monitoring, maintenance only for source-defined regimen/risk situations, and relapse evaluation for molecular recurrence.

recommendation.title: APL post-consolidation: molecular monitoring, maintenance only for source-defined regimen/risk situations, and relapse evaluation for molecular recurrence.

options.label: Molecular monitoring
options.text: PML::RARA monitoring schedule by risk/regimen.

options.label: Maintenance
options.text: Use only when source regimen/risk calls for it.

apl_low.label: Low-risk APL: ATRA + arsenic trioxide-based induction/consolidation with APL supportive care.

recommendation.title: Low-risk APL: ATRA + arsenic trioxide-based induction/consolidation with APL supportive care.

options.label: ATRA + ATO
options.text: Core low-risk approach; follow source induction/consolidation details.

options.label: Supportive care
options.text: Immediate coagulopathy/differentiation-syndrome management per APL-A.

apl_high.label: High-risk APL: ATRA + arsenic trioxide plus source-defined cytoreduction/anthracycline/GO strategy, then consolidation/monitoring.

recommendation.title: High-risk APL: ATRA + arsenic trioxide plus source-defined cytoreduction/anthracycline/GO strategy, then consolidation/monitoring.

options.label: ATRA + ATO + cytoreduction
options.text: Use source preferred high-risk regimen and supportive care.

workup.label: Suspected/confirmed acute leukemia requires complete AML evaluation, lineage/genetic characterization and urgent APL exclusion before treatment routing.

recommendation.title: Suspected/confirmed acute leukemia requires complete AML evaluation, lineage/genetic characterization and urgent APL exclusion before treatment routing.

options.label: Diagnostic evaluation
options.text: Morphology, flow, cytogenetic/FISH and rapid molecular panel including actionable mutations.

options.label: Fitness/risk assessment
options.text: Determine intensive-therapy eligibility and ELN biology before choosing non-APL AML induction.

cpx_pref.label: Intensive-eligible therapy-related/AML-MRC age ≥60: CPX-351 is a source-preferred induction option; use biology/actionable-mutation-specific alternatives when indicated.

recommendation.title: Intensive-eligible therapy-related/AML-MRC age ≥60: CPX-351 is a source-preferred induction option; use biology/actionable-mutation-specific alternatives when indicated.

options.label: CPX-351
options.text: Preferred in source-defined older therapy-related/MRC setting.

options.label: 7+3/other intensive regimen
options.text: Use source age/biology-specific alternatives; add targeted agents when mutation-specific.

cpx_other.label: Intensive-eligible therapy-related/AML-MRC younger than the source CPX-351-preference age boundary: use source-listed intensive induction options with mutation-directed additions.

recommendation.title: Intensive-eligible therapy-related/AML-MRC younger than the source CPX-351-preference age boundary: use source-listed intensive induction options with mutation-directed additions.

options.label: Intensive induction
options.text: Use source-listed CPX-351 or 7+3/other regimen according to age/biology and preference category.

options.label: Targeted addition
options.text: Add FLT3/other agent only when biomarker and regimen prerequisites are met.

cbf.label: CBF AML: CBF-directed intensive induction with source-listed gemtuzumab-containing option(s) and molecular MRD-guided consolidation.

recommendation.title: CBF AML: CBF-directed intensive induction with source-listed gemtuzumab-containing option(s) and molecular MRD-guided consolidation.

options.label: CBF induction
options.text: Use source-listed intensive CBF regimen, including GO-containing preferred/appropriate options.

options.label: Consolidation
options.text: High-dose/intermediate-dose cytarabine-based consolidation and MRD monitoring per source.

adverse.label: Intensive-eligible adverse-risk non-APL AML: source-listed intensive induction (including CPX-351 when biology/age appropriate) with early allogeneic HCT planning.

recommendation.title: Intensive-eligible adverse-risk non-APL AML: source-listed intensive induction (including CPX-351 when biology/age appropriate) with early allogeneic HCT planning.

options.label: Intensive induction
options.text: Use source adverse-risk regimen set and mutation-directed additions.

options.label: Allogeneic HCT planning
options.text: Early donor/eligibility workup for appropriate patients.

nonadverse.label: Intensive-eligible favorable/intermediate-risk AML: biology-specific intensive induction with GO/targeted additions only when source criteria are satisfied.

recommendation.title: Intensive-eligible favorable/intermediate-risk AML: biology-specific intensive induction with GO/targeted additions only when source criteria are satisfied.

options.label: 7+3-based or disease-specific intensive therapy
options.text: Select by age/biology.

options.label: Gemtuzumab ozogamicin
options.text: Use in source-defined CBF/CD33-positive favorable/intermediate settings.

options.label: FLT3-targeted addition
options.text: Use only for FLT3-mutated source-defined regimens.

lower.label: Non-APL AML not eligible for intensive induction or declining it: lower-intensity therapy with exact option prerequisites for mutation status, prior HMA exposure, and venetoclax suitability.

recommendation.title: Non-APL AML not eligible for intensive induction or declining it: lower-intensity therapy with exact option prerequisites for mutation status, prior HMA exposure, and venetoclax suitability.

options.label: HMA + venetoclax
options.text: Preferred common lower-intensity backbone when appropriate.

options.label: Mutation-directed lower-intensity therapy
options.text: Use IDH/FLT3 or other source options only with required mutation and line/eligibility conditions.

options.label: Non-venetoclax alternatives
options.text: Use source options when venetoclax is contraindicated/not appropriate or after prior HMA exposure.

cpx_reind.label: Persistent disease after CPX-351 induction: source response/reinduction branch; CPX-351 reinduction is considered only because it was used initially.

recommendation.title: Persistent disease after CPX-351 induction: source response/reinduction branch; CPX-351 reinduction is considered only because it was used initially.

options.label: CPX-351 reinduction
options.text: Applicable only when CPX-351 was the induction regimen and source response criteria are met.

options.label: Alternative salvage
options.text: Use source alternative if persistent disease or not suitable for repeat CPX-351.

other_reind.label: Persistent disease after non-CPX intensive induction: reinduction/salvage based on prior regimen, biology and clinical trial availability.

recommendation.title: Persistent disease after non-CPX intensive induction: reinduction/salvage based on prior regimen, biology and clinical trial availability.

options.label: Reinduction/salvage
options.text: Use source-listed regimen appropriate to prior induction and molecular profile.

consolidation.label: Remission after intensive induction: risk/MRD/prior-induction-directed consolidation with cytarabine-based therapy and/or allogeneic HCT.

recommendation.title: Remission after intensive induction: risk/MRD/prior-induction-directed consolidation with cytarabine-based therapy and/or allogeneic HCT.

options.label: Cytarabine-based consolidation
options.text: Exact schedule/intensity depends on age/risk/induction regimen.

options.label: Allogeneic HCT
options.text: For adverse/intermediate or MRD-positive/high-risk states when eligible.

options.label: Targeted continuation
options.text: Only when source indicates after corresponding targeted induction.

maintenance.label: AML after consolidation: maintenance or surveillance determined by transplant status, age, MRD, prior induction/consolidation and eligibility.

recommendation.title: AML after consolidation: maintenance or surveillance determined by transplant status, age, MRD, prior induction/consolidation and eligibility.

options.label: Maintenance
options.text: Use oral azacitidine/targeted maintenance only when source prerequisites are met.

options.label: Surveillance
options.text: CBC/marrow/MRD monitoring per source; treat relapse via AML-9.

rr_npm1.label: Relapsed/refractory NPM1-mutated AML: menin-inhibitor targeted therapy option(s) per current source, then response/HCT planning as appropriate.

recommendation.title: Relapsed/refractory NPM1-mutated AML: menin-inhibitor targeted therapy option(s) per current source, then response/HCT planning as appropriate.

options.label: NPM1-directed menin inhibitor
options.text: Use source-listed ziftomenib/revumenib eligibility and prior-therapy criteria.

rr_flt3_action.label: Relapsed/refractory FLT3-mutated AML: FLT3-directed salvage per prior exposure and mutation context, with HCT when feasible.

recommendation.title: Relapsed/refractory FLT3-mutated AML: FLT3-directed salvage per prior exposure and mutation context, with HCT when feasible.

options.label: FLT3 inhibitor
options.text: Use source-listed agent based on prior exposure/eligibility.

rr_idh1_action.label: Relapsed/refractory IDH1-mutated AML: IDH1-directed salvage or other source regimen; assess for HCT.

recommendation.title: Relapsed/refractory IDH1-mutated AML: IDH1-directed salvage or other source regimen; assess for HCT.

options.label: IDH1 inhibitor
options.text: Use source-listed IDH1-directed therapy according to prior exposure/eligibility.

rr_idh2_action.label: Relapsed/refractory IDH2-mutated AML: IDH2-directed salvage or other source regimen; assess for HCT.

recommendation.title: Relapsed/refractory IDH2-mutated AML: IDH2-directed salvage or other source regimen; assess for HCT.

options.label: IDH2 inhibitor
options.text: Use source-listed IDH2-directed therapy according to prior exposure/eligibility.

rr_other.label: Relapsed/refractory AML without an encoded targeted mutation: clinical trial or salvage regimen chosen by prior therapy/fitness, with allogeneic HCT if remission and eligible.

recommendation.title: Relapsed/refractory AML without an encoded targeted mutation: clinical trial or salvage regimen chosen by prior therapy/fitness, with allogeneic HCT if remission and eligible.

options.label: Clinical trial
options.text: Preferred when available.

options.label: Salvage systemic therapy
options.text: Use source-listed intensive or lower-intensity salvage.

options.label: Allogeneic HCT
options.text: Proceed in appropriate response when eligible.
